title: Yes Nichole: Beginning Your Submission
description:
Let's have a quickie. I re-recorded and remixed one of my original shorter hypnosis files. It's purely about submitting to me, relaxing and trancing to the sound of my voice, and of course- always telling me yes and obeying me. 

Attached is a completely unedited version (like the original), if you love the intimacy of being controlled by nothing but my voice.
author: Goddess Nichole
